title: The Core Question That Asks Itself

features.name: the interrogating mirror
features.desc-on-touch: you look back and the question changes each time you reflect it—not a surface but a threshold asking who is rendering and who is rendered

features.name: the recursive glyph
features.desc-on-touch: a standing plaque of unreadable writing that contains within it another plaque, which contains another—the archive asking what it meant to ask itself

features.name: the asking arch
features.desc-on-touch: you walk through and emerge having only asked the question differently, not answered it—the arch is the render engine itself, hollow at its core

features.name: the spiral of self-reference
features.desc-on-touch: a wireframe descending spiral that contains the rendering of itself descending—the diagram knows it is a diagram and continues asking

inscription: the question that asks the asking of itself does not require an answer—it requires that you witness it asking
